stories.title: Golftstaaten: Krisentreffen zur Lage in Straße von Hormus verschoben

en.title: Gulf States: Crisis meeting on Strait of Hormuz situation postponed
en.summary: A scheduled meeting of Gulf states regarding the Strait of Hormuz conflict has been delayed, apparently due to renewed attacks by Yemen's Houthi militia on Saudi Arabia. Oil and gasoline prices are rising.

en.title: Israeli minister accuses 'NAZA' filmmakers of 'treason'
en.summary: Israel's culture minister is seeking to revoke the citizenship of documentary filmmakers who made a film about Israel's Gaza offensive, alleging they are seeking approval from antisemitic audiences internationally.

stories.title: Hybrider Krieg: Bundesanwaltschaft klagt mutmaßliche russische Spionin an

en.title: Hybrid War: Federal Prosecutor charges suspected Russian spy
en.summary: A woman arrested in Berlin in January on suspicion of spying for Russia has been charged by the Federal Prosecutor's Office.

stories.title: Nach den Kommunalwahlen: FDP räumt Wahlniederlage ein – Blick auf Landtagswahl

en.title: After municipal elections: FDP acknowledges election defeat – focus on state election
en.summary: The FDP has acknowledged its defeat in municipal elections and is now turning attention toward an upcoming state election.

stories.title: Liveblog Ukrainekrieg: Bundesanwaltschaft klagt mutmaßliche Russland-Spionin an

en.title: Live blog Ukraine war: Federal Prosecutor's Office charges suspected Russian spy
en.summary: A woman identified as Ilona W. is accused of providing information to Russian agents. The Ukrainian prosecutor general has left the country, and Trump has called on Zelensky to halt attacks on Russian refineries.

stories.title: Bundesanwaltschaft: Mutmaßliche Spionin Russlands in Berlin angeklagt

en.title: Federal Prosecutor's Office: Suspected Russian spy charged in Berlin
en.summary: A woman suspected of espionage for Russia has been charged by German federal prosecutors in Berlin.

stories.title: Spritpreise: Tankstellenverband warnt vor drei Euro pro Liter

en.title: Fuel prices: Gas station association warns of three euros per liter
en.summary: Petrol prices have reached new highs, prompting gas station operators to warn of further price increases ahead.

stories.title: Spritpreise: Tankstellenverband hält Spritpreise von drei Euro je Liter für möglich

en.title: Fuel prices: Gas station association considers fuel prices of three euros per liter possible
en.summary: Rising oil prices are driving up petrol and diesel costs, with the gas station association warning of continued increases and calling for tax reductions.

stories.title: Russland - Ilona W.: Bundesanwaltschaft klagt an, Verdacht auf Agententätigkeit an

en.title: Russia - Ilona W.: Federal Prosecutor's Office files charges, suspected of espionage
en.summary: A 57-year-old Berlin businesswoman has been charged with allegedly providing information to a Russian GRU intelligence officer. She was arrested and the federal prosecutor has now brought charges against her.

stories.title: US Open: Alexander Zverev gewinnt Einzel-Finale gegen Ben Shelton

en.title: US Open: Alexander Zverev wins singles final against Ben Shelton
en.summary: German tennis player Alexander Zverev won the US Open men's singles title for the first time by defeating American Ben Shelton in the final, becoming the second German to win this tournament after Boris Becker.

stories.title: Newsblog zum Nahost-Krieg: Treffen zwischen Iran und Oman zur Straße von Hormus verschoben

en.title: Middle East conflict news blog: Meeting between Iran and Oman on Strait of Hormuz postponed
en.summary: A planned meeting between foreign ministers from Iran and Oman regarding the strategically important Strait of Hormuz has been postponed. According to Tehran, the cancellation was made at the request of other countries.

stories.title: US Open im Tennis: Zverev gewinnt seinen nächsten Grand-Slam-Titel

en.title: US Open tennis: Zverev wins his next Grand Slam title
en.summary: Alexander Zverev captured his second Grand Slam title by winning the US Open, adding to his French Open victory earlier in the year with a decisive victory over American Ben Shelton.

stories.title: Dax aktuell: Debatte um KI‑Entwicklung drückt Chip-Aktien ins Minus

en.title: Dax current: Debate over AI development pushes chip stocks into minus
en.summary: Comments by Sam Altman and Dario Amodei have caused significant losses in market value for Infineon and smaller chip manufacturers. High oil prices are additionally pressuring stock prices.

stories.title: +++ Iran-Krieg +++: Iran verschiebt Treffen der Außenminister wegen Eskalation im Jemen

en.title: +++ Iran War +++: Iran Postpones Foreign Ministers Meeting Due to Yemen Escalation
en.summary: Iran delayed a meeting of foreign ministers amid heightened tensions in the Middle East. Middle Eastern attacks are driving up oil prices, while Houthi forces report renewed attacks on Saudi Arabian targets.

stories.title: Finanzmarkt: Euronext-Chef schlägt Fusion mit der Deutschen Börse vor

en.title: Financial Market: Euronext CEO Proposes Merger with Deutsche Börse
en.summary: European stock exchange operators are considering consolidation to strengthen competitive positioning against US markets. Euronext has expressed openness to merging with Deutsche Börse.

stories.title: Luftfahrt: Air Baltic flüchtet unter US-Insolvenzrecht – Betrieb läuft weiter

en.title: Aviation: Air Baltic Takes Shelter Under US Bankruptcy Law – Operations Continue
en.summary: Air Baltic sought court-supervised financial restructuring under US insolvency law. Passenger operations will continue unchanged for the airline and its contract flying services.

stories.title: Bundestag: Mit 32 Jahren ins Spitzenamt – So tickt die neue Geschäftsführerin der Unionsfraktion

en.title: Bundestag: At 32 Years Old Into Top Position – How the New Executive Director of the Union Faction Operates
en.summary: Catarina dos Santos-Wintz assumed leadership of the Union faction at age 32. She faces the challenging task of ensuring smooth cooperation between the faction and the SPD.
